links.comparator_used: Original default responses to the same five questions, before the follow-up request to simplify the response
links.outcome: Reading level of AI answers (Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease Score and Grade Level) after a simplification request
links.effect: Default answers had Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease Scores of 35.8-41.4 and Grade Levels of 10.5-12.1. After simplification, Gemini's reading level was unchanged, ChatGPT improved to a seventh-grade level, and Copilot improved to an eighth-grade level.
links.quote: After simplification, Gemini's reading level remained unchanged, whereas ChatGPT improved to that of a seventh-grade reading level and Copilot improved to that of an eighth-grade reading level.
